sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 782)
sec.p: This archival dispatch inaugurates the **September 5** calendar walk across the Archive of American Radio. It documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story arcs, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across Louis Hector & Leigh Lovell solving Arthur Conan Doyle's *The Five Orange Pips* on *Sherlock Holmes* for Household Finance, Harold Peary blundering through school board politics on *The Great Gildersleeve* for Kraft Parkay, Captain Silver evading enemy submarines on *The Sea Hound* for Post's Raisin Bran, glamorous chanteuse Hildegarde entertaining with Frank Fay, Broadway drama on *Curtain Time* for Mars Candy, and Everett Clarke on *The Crime Files of Flamond*, Louis Hector (1936), Harold Peary (1943), and Hildegarde (1936–1946):
